target_customer: Individual Gmail users overwhelmed by newsletters and low priority email
problem: Inboxes fill with low priority mail; Forage filtered it out of Gmail and sent a daily summary with a TLDR per newsletter.
business_model: Consumer subscription with free trial, from about 8.25 dollars a month per a directory listing

founders.name: Richie Bonilla
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder on the YC launch post.

technical_complexity.rationale: Gmail integration with classification and summarisation; in 2021 language models were weaker so quality was harder to reach.

defensibility.rationale: Filtering rules and summaries were easy for SaneBox style tools or Gmail itself to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent buying it was found; G2 lists the service as shut down on 2026-03-01.

market_need_then: Email overload and newsletter clutter are widely complained about; no dated 2021 source on demand was opened.

branding.domain_note: Uses foragemail.com; the YC page lists the founder at forage.xyz.
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt page lists a launch dated 2025-02-26.

brand_strength.rationale: Name shared with other YC companies called Forage, little brand specific press found.

outcome_analysis: Forage Mail was a Gmail filtering assistant from the Summer 2021 batch that publicly launched on Product Hunt only in February 2025 and, per a G2 listing, shut down on 1 March 2026. No funding history or post-mortem was found, so the cause of the shutdown is not public.
notes: foragemail.com returned 404 on fetch. Shutdown date rests on a single directory (G2). No funding found; aggregator figures belong to other companies named Forage and were excluded. Alternatives such as SaneBox and Superhuman come from undated 2025 and 2026 pages so competitors are left empty. Founded year not found.
